description: Root HTML shell (cluster picker). Renders window.YT (clusters from clusters-config.json + parameters) and window.__DATA__ (ConfigData: settings, uiSettings, feature flags). No cluster is selected.

response.body_schema: text/html; inline scripts set window.YT = {clusters: Record<string, ClusterConfig>, isLocalCluster?: boolean, environment?: string, parameters: {interface: {version: string}, login?: string, authWay?: 'oauth'|'passwd'}} and window.__DATA__ = {userSettingsCluster?, settings: {data: Record<string, unknown>, meta: {useRemoteSettings: boolean, errorMessage?: string}}, ytApiUseCORS?, uiSettings?, metrikaCounterId?, allowPasswordAuth?, allowOAuth?, oauthButtonLabel?, allowUserColumnPresets?, odinPageEnabled, allowTabletErrorsAPI, allowPrometheusDashboards}

description: Same HTML shell for every SPA route under a cluster. Unknown cluster id -> redirect to / or a 404 explanation page.
Liveness probe of the node server itself. AuthPolicy.disabled.

HARD GATE of the cluster boot sequence. Server fans out to proxy GET /auth/whoami and GET /version. If version is missing -> PRELOAD_ERROR.CONNECTION; if token.csrf_token is missing -> PRELOAD_ERROR.AUTHENTICATION; either way the app never renders. On success the browser writes csrf_token into cookie ytfront_<cluster>_xsrf_token.

response.body_schema: {token?: {login: string, realm?: string, real_login?: string, csrf_token: string}, version?: string, tokenError?: {message, code, inner_errors}, versionError?: {message, code, inner_errors}}

description: Second HARD GATE. Server issues two execute_batch calls with the robot setup: (1) list //sys/primary_masters; (2) list //sys/media, get //sys/scheduler/orchid/service/version, get //sys/@ui_config, get //sys/@ui_config_dev_overrides, get //sys/primary_masters/<first>/orchid/service/version. Result is cached (auto-updated-cache). A non-empty mediumList.error aborts cluster init; NODE_DOES_NOT_EXIST (code 500) on ui_config / ui_config_dev_overrides / versions is tolerated.

response.body_schema: {mediumList: {output?: string[], error?: YTError}, schedulerVersion: {output?: string, error?: YTError}, uiConfig: {output?: ClusterUiConfig, error?: YTError}, uiDevConfig: {output?: ClusterUiConfig, error?: YTError}, masterVersion: {output?: string, error?: YTError}}

description: The default YT API tunnel for javascript-wrapper requests; explicit direct-transfer paths may bypass it. Command name is validated against the javascript-wrapper command table (400 on unknown). For heavy commands (read_file, write_file, read_table, write_table, select_rows, insert_rows) the server first resolves a heavy host via GET <proxy>/hosts unless clusterConfig.disableHeavyProxies or local mode. Request body and headers are piped through; JSON/urlencoded body parsers are disabled for this prefix so raw bodies survive.

headers.X-YT-Parameters-0..N: base64 JSON chunks (<=64KiB each) when useEncodedParameters
headers.X-Csrf-Token: value of cookie ytfront_<cluster>_xsrf_token; omitted when cluster authentication is 'none'

request.body: JSON parameters for commands with useBodyForParameters (get, list, exists, read_table, execute_batch, ...), otherwise the command payload

response.body_schema: streamed verbatim from the proxy; normally the YT command result. Errors carry X-YT-Error / X-YT-Response-Code / X-YT-Response-Message

description: Cluster menu decoration: calls GET <proxy>/version for every cluster in the config, in parallel, and extracts the first \d+\.\d+\.\d+ match. Failures degrade to {id} without version.
Per-cluster authorization state for the cluster menu. Without allowPasswordAuth every cluster is reported as authorized: true; with it, presence of the <cluster>_YTCypressCookie cookie decides.

Whitelisted passthrough to non-/api proxy endpoints. Only two commands are allowed: 'hosts-all' -> <proxy>/hosts/all (System > HTTP proxies page) and 'internal-discover_versions' -> <proxy>/internal/discover_versions/v2 (Components > Versions). Anything else throws.

response.body_schema: streamed from proxy; hosts-all -> Array<{host,name,role,banned,ban_message,dead,liveness}>; internal-discover_versions -> {summary, details}

description: Read the whole user-settings document from Cypress (yt.v3.get of <mapNodePath>/<username>). ONLY reachable when config.userSettingsConfig is set; otherwise the browser uses the localStorage provider and never calls this.
Idempotently create the user's settings document (yt.v3.create type=document, ignore_existing=true, attributes.value={}).

response.body_schema: YT create result (node id string) as JSON

description: Read one setting (yt.v3.get of <mapNodePath>/<username>/<path>).
Write one setting (yt.v3.set). Body is {value: <any>}; value === undefined is turned into a DELETE by the client provider.
Remove one setting (yt.v3.remove).
Pool-tree name suggestions for scheduling dialogs. Reads //sys/scheduler/config/pool_trees_root and walks the tree. Not part of the boot path.
Server-side markdown rendering for annotations/descriptions (@diplodoc/transform).
Shareable table column presets, stored in a dynamic table. Gated by config.userColumnPresets -> ConfigData.allowUserColumnPresets; absent by default.
Starts a remote-copy operation between clusters.

YT password login. Forwards Basic auth to proxy POST /login and re-emits the YTCypressCookie also as <cluster>_YTCypressCookie; strips Secure when ytAuthAllowInsecure and the origin is http://. Only mounted meaningfully when ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH is set.

request.body: {"username": string, "password": string} (raw JSON string; body parsers are disabled on /api/yt/)

response.body_schema: proxy response piped through, plus Set-Cookie: YTCypressCookie=...; <cluster>_YTCypressCookie=...

description: Clears YTCypressCookie and every <cluster>_YTCypressCookie.
Changes the YT password via yt.v4.set_user_password using the csrf token from /auth/whoami.
OpenID Connect flow. Only active when config.ytOAuthSettings is present (surfaces as ConfigData.allowOAuth).
Odin availability monitoring. Gated by config.odinBaseUrl -> ConfigData.odinPageEnabled.
Prometheus dashboards proxy. Gated by PROMETHEUS_BASE_URL -> ConfigData.allowPrometheusDashboards.
Tablet errors manager proxy. Gated by config.tabletErrorsBaseUrl -> ConfigData.allowTabletErrorsAPI.
CHYT / SPYT controller proxy. Base URLs come from //sys/@ui_config chyt_controller_base_url / livy_controller_base_url.
GitHub/GitLab browsing for the query editor. Requires uiSettings.vcsSettings; without it the controller answers 'vcsSettings is not found in UISettings'.
AI chat / code assistant. Requires ServerFactory.getAuthHeaders('aiChat') to be overridden; the OSS default returns undefined.
Access-log service. Navigation probes check-available and hides the feature on failure.
Accounts-usage service used by the Accounts detailed-usage screen, outside the Iceberg viewer. That screen probes check-available and hides the feature on failure.

Proxy version string. Called by the node server from /api/cluster-info/:c and /api/clusters/versions. The cluster-menu path extracts /(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)/, while cluster-info returns the raw text and checks only that it is truthy. A missing/failed cluster-info response yields PRELOAD_ERROR.CONNECTION and the app never renders.

response.body_schema: raw plain-text version string (NOT JSON-quoted), status 200, no Content-Type set by the real proxy

description: Identity + CSRF token mint. Called by the node server for /api/cluster-info/:c and (with password auth) by the auth middleware on every auth-enabled request. The UI stores csrf_token in cookie ytfront_<cluster>_xsrf_token; the wrapper sends it back as X-Csrf-Token only when cluster authentication is not 'none'. Missing csrf_token => PRELOAD_ERROR.AUTHENTICATION and the app never renders.

response.body_schema: {login: string, realm: string, real_login: string, csrf_token: string}; on failure 401/503 with X-YT-Error / X-YT-Response-Code / X-YT-Response-Message headers and a JSON TError body

description: Heavy-proxy discovery. The node server calls it before proxying any heavy command and uses res.data[0] as the target host. Skipped when clusterConfig.disableHeavyProxies or local mode. Real proxy: filters by role (default from coordinator/default_role_filter, itself defaulting to 'data'), drops banned/dead, sorts by a fitness function and shuffles the best half. Always 200.

headers.Accept: exactly 'text/plain' switches to newline-separated plaintext; anything else => JSON

response.body_schema: JSON array of hostname strings, e.g. ["localhost:8000"]; ports are included only when coordinator/show_ports is true

description: Full proxy inventory including dead and banned, all roles. Consumed by the UI System > HTTP proxies page via /api/yt-proxy/:c/hosts-all and mapped to {name, state: dead?'offline':'online', role, banned}.

response.body_schema: Array<{host: string, name: string, role: string, banned: boolean, ban_message: string|null, dead: boolean, liveness: {updated_at, load_average, network_coef, user_cpu, system_cpu, cpu_wait, concurrent_requests}}>

description: Proxy liveness. NOT used by the UI. Real proxy returns 503 when the coordinator considers itself unavailable (no liveness, banned, or registration older than death_age), else 200; body is always empty.
API version discovery. Not used by the UI (the wrapper hardcodes v3/v4).
Command-descriptor discovery for the given driver version. Not used by the UI.

response.body_schema: Array<{name: string, input_type: 'null'|'binary'|'structured'|'tabular', output_type: same, is_volatile: boolean, is_heavy: boolean}>

description: Driver command (v4 only) that lists proxies from //sys/{http,rpc,grpc}_proxies or the 'balancers' attribute. Exempt from authentication and executed as root. Not used by the UI.

Batched Cypress requests. The node server uses it for /api/cluster-params (two calls: //sys/primary_masters, then //sys/media + scheduler version + //sys/@ui_config + //sys/@ui_config_dev_overrides + master version). Parameters travel in the request BODY (useBodyForParameters).

response.body_schema: Array<{output?: any, error?: YTError}> in the same order as requests

description: Core Cypress reads driving the Navigation page. Sent by the browser through the node-server tunnel /api/yt/:c/api/:v/:cmd. Parameters are in the JSON body (useBodyForParameters); the wrapper omits X-YT-Parameters-* headers for these commands.

response.body_schema: v3: the raw value (optionally {$attributes,$value}); v4: wrapped as {"value": ...}

description: Heavy command; the node server resolves a host via /hosts first unless disableHeavyProxies. output_format defaults to 'json'; the UI normally asks for web_json. Parameters are in the JSON body.

response.body_schema: format-dependent stream; for web_json a single JSON object {rows, yql_type_registry, incomplete_columns, incomplete_all_column_names, all_column_names}

description: Component version inventory, surfaced on Components > Versions via /api/yt-proxy/:c/internal-discover_versions.

response.body_schema: {summary: Record<version|'total'|'error', Record<componentType, {total: number, banned: number, offline: number}>>, details: Array<instance>}

description: Cypress-cookie password login. Only mounted when the proxy has auth/cypress_cookie_manager configured. Reached from the UI only with ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH, via POST /api/yt/:c/login which converts the JSON body into an Authorization: Basic header.

response.body_schema: empty body + Set-Cookie: YTCypressCookie=<secret>; ...; 401 on bad credentials

description: Serves //sys/@cluster_connection. Not used by the UI.

response.body_schema: JSON of the cluster_connection attribute; 404 with empty body for any deeper path

description: Proxy start time + version. Not used by the UI.
